issue.title: Update stale config-test node ID in proc environment isolation fixture
issue.description: Proposed by sase-11e.8.6.5.4.5 note #1 while accepting the routine/job epic. Unrelated commit 99764a3fc7 split tests/test_config.py into focused files but left tests/test_proc_env_isolation.py::_SASE_ML_FILE_FAMILIES pointing at tests/test_config.py::test_deep_merge_list_concatenation. The test now lives in tests/test_config_merge.py. At 4e9278048a the land agent independently reproduced the exact node failure with the published sase-core-rs 0.34.41 wheel: nested pytest collects 0 items and errors because the old file is absent. Correct the hardcoded node ID and rerun the outer isolation test; preserve its inherited SASE_PROC_* and SASE_ML_FILE assertions. Search across all task statuses and the recent-week sweep found no duplicate; active epic inventory has no causal owner for this mechanical test split.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Deterministic stale pytest node ID after commit 99764a3fc7 moved the test to tests/test_config_merge.py; reproduced independently at landing, matching acceptance monitor m3mx0kg9fs18. Nested pytest errors file or directory not found and collects zero tests.
